programmes.st: Turkey's big bet to become the new energy hub
programmes.d: For decades, Turkey was heavily dependent on imported energy, spending billions on oil and gas from abroad. Now, Ankara has a bigger ambition: Not just securing its own energy future but becoming a country that helps power others. Sitting between Europe, the Middle East, the Caucasus and Central Asia, Turkey sees itself as the natural crossroads for energy flows.
